title: Wildfly: Apache Kafka's code-generated readers for flexible protocol versions read a tagged-field count declared by…
description: CVE-2026-111115 is a critical vulnerability in Apache Kafka's code-generated readers for flexible protocol versions used in Wildfly. The readers improperly handle tagged-field counts declared by the sender, retaining RawTaggedField objects for each unknown field. This flaw affects Wildfly versions prior to 42.0.0-r2 and 2.10.0-r15. The vulnerability has a high CVSS score of 9.1, indicating network exploitable with no privileges required, causing high confidentiality impact and high availability impact. A patch is available in versions 42.0.0-r2 and 2.10.0-r15.
